items.title: MECH-536 eval-time action-persistence discriminator: does a BG-like latch (persist_k2/k4, Schmitt switch cost) on the SAME frozen 978-OFF z_world reader abolish the ambitendency two-cycle WITHOUT restoring foraging competence? (+ fishtank, per-episode eval-arm badge)
items.note: EVIDENCE run; the falsifier MECH-536's own notes name (registered 2026-09-06 from thought_intake_2026-09-06_direction_blind_reactive_ambitendency.md), routed by /governance as a NEW NUMBER (a new scientific question -- what action persistence is FOR relative to representation quality -- not a 978 bug-fix letter). Routing chip chip-20260906-mech536-eval-persistence-discriminator. MECH-536 primary, MECH-535 read-across; evidence_direction_per_claim emitted for both. Different axis from V3-EXQ-1002 (landed 2026-09-05 FAIL, H-C geometry mismatch on the READOUT axis: capacity-matched adapter on the same frozen 978-OFF latent reproduces the lvg oracle at 0.66 held-out agreement vs 0.98 raw-field, cloned policy 16.9 res/ep vs 51.5) and from GFLAG-0131's stochastic-eval ask, which is carried as arm (e), a comparator, never a gate. | DESIGN: the manipulation is EVAL-TIME ONLY and the trained reader is SHARED. Training once per seed (42/43/44) reproduces 978's field_loss_off cell exactly: x734 all-ON stack, D3_hazard_free, W3_survival_zeroed, own P0a/P0/P1 warmup via x734._train_all_on_agent at zworld_p0_resource_field_weight=0.0, x734.PPOPolicyNet reader trained by x808._train_ppo_decomposed on sense-time z_world alone (32 dims); every budget/env kwarg/rung/weighting/PPO hyperparameter and _make_agent are IMPORTED from x734/x808/x978, never redefined. The (agent, net) pair is snapshotted and every eval arm runs on a fresh deep copy on a fresh env at the same seed (paired initial conditions; crf_persist_rules_across_episode_reset and goal_state carry agent state across episodes, so a shared sequential agent would leak arm order). Training cell fingerprinted via arm_cell with a declared config slice and include_driver_script_in_hash=False (mint-as-you-go). EVAL ARMS on that reader: (a) greedy_argmax = x737.LatentPPOEvalPolicy's rule, the 978 replication anchor; (b) persist_k2 -- execute the argmax for 2 consecutive steps before re-deciding; (c) persist_k4; (d) switch_cost -- MECH-266 Schmitt trigger, change action only when the new argmax logit exceeds the held action's logit by delta, where delta = the median (pre-registered RULE, quantile 0.5) of arm (a)'s own per-step switch margins per seed, realised value + n recorded; (e) stochastic_sample -- Categorical at T=1.0 (GFLAG-0131 comparator). The reader's forward pass runs every step in every arm; only the EXECUTED action differs; decided and executed actions both recorded per step. ANCHORS: random_walk, local_view_greedy, local_view_greedy_persist_k2 (pre-registered expectation: a latch does not hurt a good representation; C3, reported; failure adds a caveat to MECH-536's 'protective, not necessary' framing). CONTAMINATION-OFF SUB-GRID: arms (a) and (b) re-run at contamination_spread=0.0 (V3-EXQ-513 idiom) so cycle-truncation death is separated from the cycle; health_depleted rate and survival_horizon recorded per arm; C2_survival_matched reported. | DVs: foraging_competence via _lib.capability_eval.evaluate_seed (the SAME number 978 reports, not reimplemented); cycle_incidence = fraction of the SCORED eval episodes whose position trace contains a two-cell period-2 orbit of length >= 6 steps (p[i]!=p[i+1], p[j]==p[j+2]) -- the trace is recorded by the policy wrapper at act() time as a side-channel DURING evaluate_seed, so the detector runs on the scored episodes and the DV loop is untouched; secondary: survival_horizon, unique_cells, fixed_point_incidence (stationary >= 90%), bounded_orbit_incidence + per-arm orbit-period histogram (a k-latched two-cycle can become a period-2k orbit over 3 cells, still contamination-lethal -- 'cycle gone' must not silently mean 'cycle longer'), resources per 100 survived steps, per-step top-2 and switch logit margins. DETECTOR CONTRACT: --self-test runs the detector on the 978 episode log (Mac copy) and it fires on exactly 10/12 episodes and on neither fixed point (verified 2026-09-07; 24/24 checks incl. synthetic cases and the adjudication grid + two boolean-cube invariants); run_experiment refuses to start if the self-test fails. | ONE FACT THE BRIEF DID NOT STATE, found at authoring: 978's scored OFF arm cycles on seed 42 ONLY (competence 0.00, survival 50.75, death_rate 0.80); seeds 43/44 survived all 200 steps with death_rate 0.00 (competence 0.25/0.55), and a two-cell cycle under contamination cannot survive 200 steps, so those seeds are fixed-point/wandering. The latch reaches the DV only through CYCLING episodes (a wall-press repeats one action), so C1 is conditioned PER SEED on the greedy anchor cycling on that seed (cycle_incidence >= 0.25), n_cycle_present_seeds is recorded and carried into criteria_non_degenerate, and the C1 verdict may rest on ONE seed -- stated in the docstring so nobody reads it as three. No seed cycling -> greedy_cycle_absent_manipulation_unreachable (non_contributory). Greedy clearing the 1.0 floor on any seed -> anchor_replication_failed_greedy_supra_floor (non_contributory). | PRE-REGISTERED VERDICTS (MECH-536 notes, operationalised, not softened). Verdict arms = persist_k2 AND persist_k4 (parameter-free pure latches); switch_cost carries its own C1/C2 flags and is reported, never adjudicated (its delta is a free parameter whose strength is unknown before the run). C1: on cycle-present seeds a strict majority have cycle_incidence <= 0.05 on each verdict arm. C2: on EVERY seed and each verdict arm, competence < 1.0 AND per-seed lift over (a) < max(0.5 res/ep absolute, 2 x SD of the per-seed lift) -- SD on the DELTA plus an absolute floor per feedback_effect_size_pass_gate_margin; the brief's 'seed SD of (a)' term is 2 x 0.22 = 0.45 at 978's values, subsumed by the absolute floor and recorded alongside. C1 AND C2 -> PASS latch_abolishes_cycle_competence_flat_representational_deficit, MECH-536 supports, MECH-535 supports. NOT C1 -> latch_did_not_abolish_cycle_non_contributory (both non_contributory) -- note a pure k>=2 latch abolishes a period-2 orbit BY CONSTRUCTION (actions come in runs of k), so C1 on (b)/(c) is the manipulation-reached-the-DV check and its failure is an instrumentation defect, not a finding; the science is in C2 and in what replaces the cycle. C1 AND NOT C2 -> split by ONE refinement made at authoring: the latch also removes contamination death (a latched agent lives ~200 steps instead of ~11 and any straight-line runner crosses more food by opportunity alone), so a rise that stays INSIDE what undirected motion achieves is not restored direction: latch competence > random_walk anchor on a strict majority of seeds OR >= 1.0 on any seed -> latch_restores_competence_gating_deficit_route_arc107_root_c, MECH-536 weakens, MECH-535 weakens; otherwise latch_lift_within_undirected_envelope, MECH-536 mixed (a MEASURED equivocal effect), MECH-535 unknown. Gate: zworld_encoder_trained_in_p0 (>= 1e-6), d3_local_view_greedy_clears_floor (>= 1.0, closes the 732a privileged-oracle confound), greedy_reader_subfloor_replication (< 1.0), greedy_cycle_present_on_some_seed (>= 0.25) -- all numeric measured/threshold/direction so the indexer recomputes met. NON-DEGENERACY: C1 needs >= 1 cycle-present seed with latch cycle incidence differing from greedy's (check_degeneracy groups); C2 needs the latch to have CREATED OPPORTUNITY (verdict arms outlive greedy on every cycle-present seed); identical competence on fixed-point seeds is NOT read as degenerate (the latch changes nothing there by construction; lvg 45.75 certifies the DV is live). | DV-SYMMETRY per arm: DV = consumption count / a predicate on the position trace; each arm rewrites the EXECUTED action sequence, hence the trajectory generating both DVs. persist_k: replaces argmax(logits_t) by argmax(logits_{t-j}) -- not a broadcast constant on the logits, not a monotone rescaling, not a permutation; switch_cost adds delta to the HELD action's effective score only (asymmetric, argmax can change); stochastic_sample replaces the argmax by a draw; the lvg latch anchor is the same rewrite. Path open in every arm. | GOV-REUSE-1 (step 2.4): decisive readouts are cycle_incidence and competence of the frozen 978-OFF reader under an eval-time persistence rule. No manifest under evidence/experiments/ carries any persistence/latch eval (grep MECH-536|persist_k|latch: 0 hits); 978 (substrate_hash 21d9e701...) recorded greedy-argmax eval only and its per-step traces exist only in the seed-42 episode log; 1002 (5125cc63...) recorded adapter agreement and cloned competence, a different instrument. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> run required. | RE-DERIVE BRAKE (step 2.5b): does not fire -- MECH-535 and MECH-536 were registered 2026-09-06 and have 0 counted autopsies each. STEP 2.5/2.5a: no new substrate is exercised -- the manipulation is driver-side eval wrapper code on the 978 stack that already ran; the one-tick probe is the dry-run itself (all five arms + three anchors + both contamination-off cells constructed and stepped on a deep-copied reader) and the --self-test detector contract. STEP 2.5c: open corrupting entries listing ree_core/agent.py (mode-governance-engagement, SD-082), tonic_vigor.py (MECH-320), e1_deep.py::forward/::predict_long_horizon (SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training), ContextMemory.write, blocked_agency.py -- the eval-path substrate call is agent.sense() ONLY (x737._agent_zworld); use_salience_coordinator / use_tonic_vigor / use_blocked_agency / e1_rollout_consistency are default-off in this config, sd016_writepath_mode is 'off', and lateral_pfc compute_bias (SD-082) sits on the select_action path the reader never calls; training runs the imported x734 recipe unchanged since 978 (which ran under the same open entries) and because the reader is SHARED any training-path effect is a constant across every eval arm and cannot produce an arm contrast. SD-018 (degrading; stack.py / zworld_p0.py) is on the training path -- recorded, not blocking. ETHICS PREFLIGHT: all-false / allow (hazard-free rung, no harm stream in the eval loop). | FISHTANK: a separate observational log pass (NOT the scored data; 978's pattern) re-runs every eval arm, both contamination-off cells and the three anchors from a fresh copy of the trained snapshot on a fresh env (seed + 7777), LOG_EPISODES=6 each, first seed only; per-episode `arm` = the EVAL arm id (REE_assembly 2e10701d76 renders a per-episode arm badge, so the arms are watchable side by side), per step 978's fields (pos/action/health/energy/z_world_norm/the three resource_field argmax series/resource_field_max/hazards/resources) plus decided_action, executed_action, held, top2_margin, switch_margin. Recorded generously (feedback_fishtank_telemetry_maximalism). | COST: 978 trained 6 cells in 17.4 h on ree-worker-3; this run trains 3 (one reader per seed, 60 P0a + 200 P0 + 90 P1-REINFORCE + 1000 P1-PPO) and adds 10 cheap eval cells plus a 10-arm x 6-episode log pass per seed -> ~11 h estimated, 700 min. episodes_per_run 1350 follows 978's convention (the per-seed TRAINING budget; the 9 non-training conditions per seed train nothing); conditions 10 = the verdict lines per seed (5 eval arms + 3 anchors + 2 contamination-off cells). sleep_driver_pattern='none' declared. | SMOKE: --dry-run PASS (2026-09-07, 4th attempt on the final code; the first three surfaced and fixed two real defects in the frozen-snapshot copy: torch refuses deepcopy of the agent's non-leaf tensors (_committed_candidates, _last_action, _last_e3_selection_result -- 92 detached into leaves per copy) and of the `random` module held as hippocampal._rng (shared as a process singleton), both handled by a scoped deepcopy shim recorded as snapshot_detached_nonleaf_tensors). Exit 0 with one training cell + all five eval arms + three anchors + both contamination-off cells constructed and stepped on deep-copied readers (persist_k2 held-step fraction 0.50, persist_k4 0.75, so the latch engages), the fishtank log built with 20 episodes across 10 arm ids, 10 verdict lines per seed, [train] ep N/M progress lines, the correct dry-scale self-route greedy_cycle_absent_manipulation_unreachable with MECH-536 non_contributory / MECH-535 unknown, arm_results fingerprint reuse_eligible=True with driver_script_in_substrate_hash=False, z_goal_stream no writer defect (writer_calls 160). validate_recording.py --strict: 1 complete, 0 gaps. validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings across all 31 checks. --self-test 28/28 (detector on the 978 log: exactly 10/12 cycling, 2 fixed points, none overlapping; adjudication grid + 3 cube invariants). The final docstring sentence recording the F8 probe result postdates the 4th smoke and is comment-only. | red-team (fable): CONTESTED (no BLOCKING); one pass, not iterated. Four findings VERIFIED AT SOURCE and APPLIED before queueing: F1 -- C2's 'below the 1.0 floor on every seed' conjunct and the random-walk envelope were knife-edge on non-cycle seeds (on seed 44, greedy 0.55, a latch at 0.95 read supports/supports and at 1.00 read weakens/weakens for BOTH claims: one resource in 20 episodes), so clearing 1.0 or beating random_walk now counts as a rise only when the seed's lift also clears the effect floor; F2 -- the effect floor max(0.5, 2 x SD of the lifts) inflated on heterogeneous lifts (lifts [+0.90,-0.25,-0.55] gave floor 1.25 and read a 0.90 rise on the cycle seed as flat): for a NULL criterion the SD term runs the wrong way, so the floor is now the CONSTANT C2_EFFECT_FLOOR=0.5 (half the family floor and ~2 x the 978 OFF seed SD of 0.22, the brief's term frozen at authoring), SDs recorded alongside; F3 -- C2's non-degeneracy on survival alone was satisfied by a boundary press (a blocked move never enters a cell, so never contaminates) and by a k-latched period-4 orbit that dies a few steps later, so it now also requires the verdict arms to visit >= 3 more unique cells than greedy on every cycle-present seed, and a verdict arm that is a fixed point on >= 50% of a cycle-present seed's episodes is recorded as the caveat latch_converted_cycle_to_fixed_point; F4 -- MECH-535 could only ever be supported (a no-cycle gate was filtered as non_contributory), so the no-cycle branch now emits MECH-535 weakens when the greedy reader showed NEITHER a cycle NOR a fixed point on a strict majority of seeds (phenotype not replicated) and unknown for a stupor-only replication; the same seeds as 978 mean MECH-535 support is a re-observation plus the latch dissociation, said so in the docstring, fresh-seed replication owed. Four informational findings RECORDED, not fixed: F5 contamination_spread=0 zeroes contamination_view = world_state[175:200], an input the reader trained with live, so the sub-grid is off-distribution for the encoder -- recorded_checks.contamination_off_greedy_cycle_present says whether the survival-matched cycle held (sub-grid is reported, never gating); F6 C1 is a tautology for a pure k>=2 latch (a mirror self-test row added), the verdict rests on C2 -- already stated in the docstring; F7 a seed on which greedy never switches action gives delta=0 so arm (d) duplicates (a) there -- metrics.switch_cost_degenerate_seeds lists them; F8 this driver reseeds torch/numpy before every eval arm whereas 978 evaluated straight after PPO -- PROBED at authoring: agent.sense() is RNG-free (bit-identical z_world under two global seeds, torch RNG state unchanged by a sense() call), so the greedy replication is unaffected. The reviewer also cleared two hazards it checked itself: the shared `random` module in the deep-copied hippocampal._rng is consumed only on the replay path (module.py:2969/3010), not in sense(); and the env owns a private default_rng(seed), so arms are env-paired regardless of global RNG. Self-test after the fixes: 28/28 incl. a cube invariant that MECH-535 weakens on a red gate only via the no-cycle branch with phenotype absent.
